Every 'range' and every 'assumption' below is a HUMAN claim with a citation and a
proof method. The checker does arithmetic and drift detection only; it does not
derive bounds from Rust source and must never be described as if it did.

pipeline_anchors_comment: Correction 7 / chatgpt_1 review B7. The `census` above only sees lines carrying the
token `score`. Five of the ten findings (X5, X6, X8, X9, X10) do not live on such a
line, so the census could stay green while they changed. Each anchor below freezes a
whole function body, located structurally by name + definition line and fingerprinted
over the whitespace-stripped RAW body text. Drift in a node INVALIDATES every finding
listed in its `findings` field: that record must be re-derived before it is restated.
Coverage is per-node, not per-program: a load-bearing node not listed here is not
covered, and adding one is a manual step (method packet S6 step 5).

range_models.note: Worked example A of the method packet. Reproduces the corrected chop bound (1500 base / 2400 with the absolute denial term). NOTE: the .max(1) clamp is reported DEAD whether or not chop_turns>=1 is propagated, because the `+1` literal alone forces the operand >= 1. Clamp-deadness is therefore NOT what catches the original manifest error; the propagated attainable interval of `turns` ([2,inf) vs [1,inf), giving 2400 vs 3900) is. See the packet, S2.5.

intentions_comment: Frozen intention registry (method packet S4.1). ELEVEN labels -- the audit's prose said nine
and then listed eleven (chatgpt_1 C5). Assignment of a site to a label is a HUMAN judgement,
frozen here so two auditors agree by reading the same ledger rather than by judging alike.
Disagreement is resolved by amending this section and re-running, never by re-arguing in prose.

intentions.gloss: clear a unit off the unique shack door by forced DROP
PICK a fruit to replant the orchard
deposit carried goods at the shack
PLANT a fruit at a shack-adjacent cell
endgame PICK/MOVE that converts inventory into score
acquire the material a unit is missing
vacate the shack cell so a TRAIN can be issued
chop a tree for wood and return it
harvest fruit when there is nothing else to do

priority.note: NO priority relation over the eleven intentions is declared by the subject, by the audit, or by the owner. Consequence, and it is load-bearing: any two intentions are INCOMPARABLE, so no claim of the form 'J outranks I' is admissible from this ledger. Every finding below is therefore a statement about mechanism and range, not about a violated ordering. Declaring a relation is an owner action, not an agent action.

witnesses_comment: EMPTY, and that is the finding (chatgpt_1 B3). A STATE_WITNESSED label requires a committed
packet pinned to the exact subject 98628e98: literal input state, the FULL candidate surface at
that state, the selection result, the candidate identity, the extraction method and a content
hash. No such packet exists for this subject. The episode names cited by the audit (m085-s0,
m014-s1) are saved transcripts of different candidate identities. X2 and X9 are therefore
DEMOTED to SOURCE_PROVED here. validate_ledger() fails the run if any finding claims
STATE_WITNESSED without a witness record whose subject_sha256 is the pinned subject.
findings_comment: Typed X1-X10 records (method packet S4.4). `rule_answers` are the HUMAN answers to the eight
S4.3 predicates; the checker applies the fixed first-match order to them and REJECTS the ledger
if the declared `class`/`rule` is not what that order produces. The order is thus mechanical and
auditable; the predicates are not, and nothing here pretends otherwise.
`anchors` names the frozen pipeline nodes (see pipeline_anchors) whose drift invalidates the record.

findings.reason: rule 5 -- one intention (CONVERT) priced by two branches of a clock test: `view.turn>250` at R:1291 and R:1323 selects 7_000-priority / 6_000-priority-travel against the pre-250 750/(turns+3) form, whose modelled range is (0, 187.5]

rule 6 -- the same CONVERT label is priced by two branches selected on the agent's own position: the R:1290 on-door branch prices only `unit.cell`, the R:1303 off-door branch prices every shack-start cell. Rule 2 does not fire: the label is present in both branches, so this is a target-set restriction, not an admission suppression
findings.promotion_requires: a committed exact-98628e98 witness packet: literal input state, full candidate surface at that state, the selection result, the candidate identity and the SHA of the tool that produced them. The earlier `m085-s0` citation is a saved transcript of a different candidate identity and is not admissible (chatgpt_1 B3)

findings.reason: rule 6 -- one SEED site R:1261-1265 branching on `at_target = unit.cell == *cell`: 9_000 in place versus 8_000 - dist when moving

rule 4 does not fire (EQUIP-IRON and EQUIP-FRUIT are different goals) and rule 7 does not fire (no accumulation within one expression); rule 8 -- R:501 subtracts a RAW BFS cell count while R:479 subtracts turns, so two sites of neighbouring bands are denominated in different units with no declared separator

rule 3 -- the discontinuity is in the post-scoring stage: `select` maximises a.score + b.score over compatible pairs at R:683, so a pair of two mid-priced candidates can beat a pair containing the highest-priced one
rule 2 -- the BANK label can be absent from the candidate set entirely: the YamoBot filter at R:947-955 can empty a set that MoisanBot::bank_candidates guaranteed non-empty

rule 4 -- one intention-and-goal, CLEAR-FOR-TRAIN, is priced at two distinct sites by two different mechanisms: a soft 6_500 candidate appended at R:1422 and a forced 20_000 whole-list replacement at R:962/R:987. Rule 2 does not fire because the label is present on both paths
findings.note: the separate claim that the forced 20_000 outranks six other intentions is REACHABILITY_HYPOTHESIS and is not asserted here (chatgpt_1 C7)

findings.reason: rule 2 -- R:1282-1286 overwrites the CHOP candidate's score to 10_000 and returns immediately, so every other intention label is absent from the candidate set for that unit on that turn
rule 3 -- the post-scoring compatibility filter R:643-646 returns true whenever either target is Target::None, so the only cross-unit constraint vanishes for WAIT-targeted candidates
findings.promotion_requires: a committed exact-98628e98 witness packet as for X2; the earlier `m014-s1` citation is a saved transcript of a different candidate identity and is not admissible (chatgpt_1 B3)

findings.reason: rule 2 -- R:1413 admits the IDLE-HARVEST label only when every already-built candidate has Target::None, so the label is absent by control flow in every other state
